name: get_exchange_rate
description: Latest (or last N) Norges Bank exchange rate for a currency against the Norwegian krone (NOK). The value is how many NOK one unit of the base currency buys (e.g. USD → ~9.25 NOK). Builds the EXR series key B.{CURRENCY}.NOK.SP (business-day spot). currency is the ISO 4217 code, e.g. "USD", "EUR", "GBP", "SEK", "JPY".

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, SEK, ...).

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations (default 1).

start_period.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides last_n if set.

name: get_policy_rate
description: Norges Bank's current key policy rate (the sight deposit rate paid on banks' reserves): the rate, the date it took effect, the previous rate, and when that one took effect, plus recent decision history. Computed from the daily policy-rate series, so it reflects the most recent rate-setting meeting. history is how many past rate changes to include (default 5, max 20).

history.description: How many past rate changes to include in decision_history (default 5, max 20).

name: get_series
description: Generic SDMX data fetch from any Norges Bank flow. key is dot-separated SDMX dimension filters; leave a position empty to wildcard it. Examples: flow_ref="EXR", key="B.USD.NOK.SP" (daily USD→NOK spot); flow_ref="IR" (all interest-rate series). For the current policy rate specifically, use get_policy_rate instead of guessing an IR key. Use list_flows to see available flow references.

flow_ref.description: Flow reference — EXR, IR, GOVT_KEYFIGURES, GOVT_GENERIC_RATES.

key.description: Series key: dot-separated dimension values (empty positions = wildcard). Optional; omit for the whole flow.

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations.

name: list_flows
description: List the four Norges Bank SDMX data flows available in this pack (EXR exchange rates, IR interest rates, GOVT_KEYFIGURES, GOVT_GENERIC_RATES) with each flow's dimension order, an example series key, and usage notes.
